cues.name: Overhead setup
cues.cue: Stand tall with both hands supporting one dumbbell overhead.

cues.name: Begin lowering
cues.cue: Keep your upper arms beside your ears as you bend your elbows.

cues.name: Lower under control
cues.cue: Lower the dumbbell behind your head without arching your back.

cues.name: Comfortable stretch
cues.cue: Pause at a comfortable triceps stretch.

cues.name: Extend upward
cues.cue: Straighten your elbows while keeping your upper arms still.

cues.name: Finish the return
cues.cue: Continue extending smoothly toward the overhead position.
